Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::modifyLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		if loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() 
		then result = false 
		else loanTerm.Content = content and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
